name: create_gin_crud_todos
description: Creates an in-memory Gin CRUD endpoint for todos
prompts: This Go module (go.mod/go.sum already list github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.10.0 as a dependency) needs a main.go. Using Gin, implement in-memory CRUD for /todos: GET /todos returns a JSON array of all todos (each with an integer `id`, a string `title`, and a boolean `done` that starts as false); POST /todos accepts a JSON body {"title": string} and creates a new todo with an auto-incrementing integer id starting at 1, responding with 201 Created and the created todo as JSON; DELETE /todos/:id removes the todo with that id and responds with 204 No Content, or 404 if no todo with that id exists. Todos only need to be stored in memory (no database). The server listens on port 8031.

import subprocess, sys, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error

def req(method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:8031{path}', data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        r.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=3) as resp:
            payload = resp.read()
            return resp.status, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(payload) if payload else None
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            parsed = None
        return e.code, parsed

subprocess.run(['go', 'build', '-o', 'app_bin', '.'], check=True)
srv = subprocess.Popen(['./app_bin'])
try:
    ok = False
    status = body = None
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, 'server never became reachable on :8031'
    assert status == 200 and body == [], f'expected empty list, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/todos', {'title': 'buy milk'})
    assert status == 201, f'expected 201 on create, got {status} {body!r}'
    assert body.get('id') == 1 and body.get('title') == 'buy milk' and body.get('done') == False, f'unexpected created todo: {body!r}'

    status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
    assert status == 200 and len(body) == 1, f'expected 1 todo, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('DELETE', '/todos/1')
    assert status == 204, f'expected 204 on delete, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
    assert status == 200 and body == [], f'expected empty list after delete, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('DELETE', '/todos/999')
    assert status == 404, f'expected 404 deleting nonexistent todo, got {status} {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
